risks: model ranking does not hold across windows
only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~19% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.107), which favours a robust combination.

attempts.agent_rationale: Test the pooled meta‑model weight vector w1 on the full pool to see if it beats the best single ARIMA.

attempts.rationale: Test the best_single strategy with ARIMA to see if a single top model outperforms the mean baseline.
Test a trimmed‑mean over the full pool to see if trimming the extreme models improves over best_single ARIMA.
Test a robust median over the most stable pool (pool1) to see if it beats the best single ARIMA and the mean baseline.
Test a robust median over the most consistent pool (pool3) to see if it can beat the best single ARIMA.
Test a DTW barycenter over the most stable pool (pool1) to see if it beats the best single ARIMA.
Test a robust median over pool2 to see if it beats best_single ARIMA.
Test a DTW barycenter over pool2 to see if a different pool improves over previous dba and other medians.
Test a weighted combination using inverse-error weighting on a stable subset (pool2) to see if it beats the best single ARIMA.
Test a weighted combination using the inverse_error weights (w2) on the full pool to see if it improves over the best_single ARIMA.
Test a trimmed‑mean over the more diverse pool4 to see if trimming extremes improves over the best single ARIMA.
Test a plain mean over pool4 to see if a simple average of the more stable models beats the current best single ARIMA.
Test a robust DBA approach on the more stable pool4 to see if it can beat the current best single ARIMA.

decision.justification: Selected 'mean' (a seeded deterministic baseline) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score -0.1291. Series context: trend strength 0.8483 and seasonal strength 0.2715; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.107); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.491.
